🏠 LANDLORDS — PROPERTIES WANTED FOR EMERGENCY & TEMPORARY ACCOMMODATION

We’re currently looking to work with landlords, letting agents and property managers who have suitable properties available across London, Essex, Surrey and surrounding areas.

We can offer landlords a long-term commercial arrangement, providing a more straightforward and hands-off alternative to the traditional private rental market.

✅ Long-term commercial lease options
✅ Guaranteed rent arrangements
✅ Professional property management
✅ Emergency & temporary accommodation use
✅ Long-term placements available
✅ Reliable rental income
✅ Hands-off management for landlords
✅ Multiple properties/portfolios welcome

We are particularly looking for:

🏡 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5-bedroom properties
📍 London | Essex | Surrey & surrounding areas

Whether your property is currently vacant, becoming available soon, or you’re considering moving away from the traditional private rental market, we’d be happy to discuss the options available.

📩 Get in touch with the property postcode, number of bedrooms and your expected monthly rent.

We’re also keen to build relationships with letting agents, sourcing agents and landlords with multiple properties.
